name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou: Shiroi Kage no Shoujo
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 白い影の少女
source:
When [url=/c65]Jinguuji Saburou[/url] attends his friend's funeral, his friend's mother asks him to investigate a missing person, while police inspector Kumano asks him to investigate the urban myth called "Yuu-chan".

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Jing%C5%ABji_Sabur%C5%8D]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
[url=/c65]神宫寺三郎[/url]参加朋友的葬礼时，朋友的母亲请他调查一桩失踪案；与此同时，熊野警部也委托他调查名为“小优”的都市传说。

[改编自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Jing%C5%ABji_Sabur%C5%8D]Wikipedia[/url]]
